name: GPT-5.6 Sol Ultrafast on Cerebras CS-4: 750 output tokens/sec
methodology: Vendor benchmark, single-stream decode, GPT-5.6 Sol Ultrafast mode on Cerebras CS-4. No batch size or concurrency specified. Comparison: 11x faster than Fable 5, 5x faster than Opus 4.8 Fast mode.
notes: Vendor claim from Cerebras blog (Aug 13, 2026). This is a single-stream decode throughput figure for a specific model (GPT-5.6 Sol) in Ultrafast mode. No independent third-party verification. The figure is for the CS-4 system with 3 WSE-3 Turbo wafers. Cerebras publishes no standard benchmark (MLPerf) results.
